content.text: {"verdict":"proceed_with_assumptions","summary":"The paper gives the cell lines, siRNA sequences, 27 nM final siRNA dose, Interferin as the reagent, 1% O2 hypoxia for 24 h, Passive Lysis Buffer plus Luciferase Assay System, and protein (Bradford) normalisation. Seeding density, per-well volumes, the siRNA/hypoxia timeline, lysis volume and luminometer settings are not stated. Manufacturer manuals resolve the Interferin and luciferase details, and the rest have defensible standard defaults, so no gap is missing.","gaps":[{"detail":"Interferin volume, complexation medium volume, complexation time and final volume per 35 mm well for 27 nM siRNA","why_needed":"Transfection efficiency and knockdown depend on the reagent:siRNA ratio and complex formation. The paper only says Interferin at 27 nM in 35 mm plates.","status":"resolved","resolution":"Polyplus/Sartorius INTERFERin Table 3 (10–50 nM siRNA, 6-well/35 mm): 12 ± 4 µL INTERFERin, 200 µL serum-free medium (or Opti-MEM) for complexation, 2 mL complete medium on cells, 2.2 mL final volume. 27 nM in 2.2 mL is about 59 pmol siRNA. Vortex INTERFERin 5 s and spin it down. Add INTERFERin to the diluted siRNA, vortex 10 s, incubate 10 min at room temperature (do not exceed 30 min), then add the mix to the cells and swirl. For reverse transfection, add the mix to the plate and then overlay the cell suspension.","source":"https://api.sartorius.com/document-hub/dam/download/282472/siRNA-miRNA-Transfection-Reagent-INTERFERin-Protocol-en-Sartorius.pdf"},{"detail":"Cell seeding density per 35 mm dish for U2OS, MDA-MB-231 and HeLa HRE-luciferase lines","why_needed":"Confluency at transfection and at harvest (48 h, including 24 h hypoxia) affects knockdown, HIF signal and luciferase output.","status":"assumable","resolution":"The paper gives no cell numbers. Use the Interferin recommendation of about 150,000 ± 50,000 cells per 35 mm/6-well in 2 mL, aiming for 30–50% confluency at transfection. For reverse transfection, plate the same number straight into the transfection mix. Adjust per line so that cells are sub-confluent at harvest. Seed identical numbers for all siRNA and oxygen conditions of a given line.","source":"standard practice; INTERFERin manual Table 1 (https://api.sartorius.com/document-hub/dam/download/282472/siRNA-miRNA-Transfection-Reagent-INTERFERin-Protocol-en-Sartorius.pdf)"},{"detail":"Order and timing of siRNA transfection versus hypoxia start (forward vs reverse transfection)","why_needed":"The Fig 1 legend says siRNA for 48 h and 1% O2 for 24 h, but does not say when hypoxia starts. Hypoxia onset relative to knockdown changes the readout.","status":"assumable","resolution":"Reverse-transfect at t=0. Move the hypoxia plates to the 1% O2 workstation at 24 h post-transfection (the paper does this in the proliferation assay: hypoxia starts 24 h after reverse transfection). Keep the normoxia plates at 21% O2. Lyse both sets at 48 h, with the hypoxic plates lysed inside the workstation as the paper states.","source":"Methods s4.11, s4.3, Fig 1B legend; standard practice"},{"detail":"siRNA duplex format (overhangs/modifications) and stock concentration","why_needed":"The table lists only 19-nt sense sequences from IDT, and the dose is 27 nM.","status":"assumable","resolution":"Use annealed, unmodified 19-mer RNA duplexes as ordered from IDT. Control: CAGUCGCGUUUGCGACUGG. KDM2B_1: CCACUGCAAGUCUAUCACA. KDM2B_2: GGGAGUGUCCGAAGUGUAA. Resuspend to a 20 µM stock in RNase-free buffer or water. Use about 59 pmol (about 3 µL of 20 µM) per 2.2 mL well. Whether the oligos carry dTdT overhangs is not stated, so confirm against the IDT order.","source":"standard practice; Reagents table s4.1"},{"detail":"Selection antibiotics (puromycin) during the experiment","why_needed":"Puromycin at 0.5 µg/mL is listed for the HRE lines in culture. The text lists only the U2OS, MDA-MB-231 and HEK293 lines, not HeLa-HRE, and does not say whether it is kept during transfection.","status":"assumable","resolution":"Maintain the lines in 0.5 µg/mL puromycin during routine culture. Omit puromycin during the siRNA experiment, because it is standard practice to avoid selection drugs during lipid transfection. Use the same medium conditions for all lines.","source":"Methods s4.2; standard practice"},{"detail":"Handling of medium and plates in hypoxia (pre-equilibration, medium change)","why_needed":"The paper gives only the workstation conditions: Invivo2 300, 1% O2, 5% CO2, 37 °C, with lysis inside the chamber. Oxygen in the medium affects how fast HIF is induced.","status":"assumable","resolution":"Place the plates in the workstation without a medium change at 24 h post-transfection. Pre-equilibrate the PBS and lysis buffer in the chamber (or keep them ice-cold in the chamber). Do all rinsing and lysis inside the workstation so cells are never reoxygenated.","source":"Methods s4.3; standard practice"},{"detail":"Passive Lysis Buffer working concentration and volume per 35 mm dish; lysis procedure","why_needed":"The paper only says cells were lysed in Passive Lysis Buffer. The luciferase signal and the Bradford normalisation both depend on lysate concentration.","status":"assumable","resolution":"E1941 is a 5X stock. Dilute 1 part buffer with 4 parts water and equilibrate to room temperature. Rinse cells once with PBS and remove it fully. Add about 300 µL 1X PLB per 35 mm well; Promega gives 250 µL per 12-well and 400 µL per 60 mm dish and has no 35 mm figure. Rock or shake about 15 min at room temperature, and scrape if needed. Transfer to a tube, vortex 10–15 s, and centrifuge briefly (12,000 × g, 15 s at room temperature or up to 2 min at 4 °C). Keep the supernatant on ice for the luciferase and Bradford assays, or freeze at –70 °C.","source":"https://www.promega.com/-/media/files/resources/protocols/technical-bulletins/0/luciferase-assay-system-protocol.pdf (TB281); Dual-Luciferase manual https://www.promega.com/-/media/files/resources/protocols/technical-manuals/0/dual-luciferase-reporter-assay-system-protocol.pdf"},{"detail":"Luciferase Assay System procedure (E1500) and luminometer settings","why_needed":"The paper says only that activity was measured using the kit. Reagent preparation, volumes and read time are needed to repeat it.","status":"resolved","resolution":"Reconstitute the lyophilised Luciferase Assay Substrate in Luciferase Assay Buffer to make Luciferase Assay Reagent. Equilibrate it to room temperature, and store aliquots at –70 °C. For a manual luminometer: dispense 100 µL reagent per tube, add 20 µL cell lysate, mix by pipetting 2–3 times (or briefly vortex), and read with a 2 s delay and a 10 s read. For plate readers, use the same 20 µL lysate : 100 µL reagent ratio. Use the same read time for all samples. The luminometer model is not given in the paper, so use an available one and report it.","source":"https://www.promega.com/-/media/files/resources/protocols/technical-bulletins/0/luciferase-assay-system-protocol.pdf (TB281, Sections 3 and 4.A)"},{"detail":"Bradford protein assay details for normalising luciferase","why_needed":"Luciferase is normalised to protein, but the paper gives no sample volume, standard or wavelength.","status":"assumable","resolution":"Dilute Bio-Rad Protein Assay Dye Reagent Concentrate 1:5 with water. Run a BSA standard curve (for example 0.05–0.5 mg/mL) in the same PLB diluted to match the samples. Mix a small lysate volume (1–5 µL, diluted if needed) with the diluted dye, incubate at room temperature for at least 5 min, and read at 595 nm. Report luciferase as RLU per µg protein, normalised to the control siRNA normoxia sample per cell line.","source":"https://users.pfw.edu/blumenth/LabData/BioradLab.pdf and Bio-Rad Protein Assay manual https://www.bio-rad.com/webroot/web/pdf/lsr/literature/LIT33.pdf; standard practice"}],"retrieved_details":"Paper (s4.2–s4.4, s4.9, Fig 1B legend): DMEM + 10% FBS + 2 mM L-glutamine + 100 U/mL penicillin + 100 µg/mL streptomycin; HRE reporter lines (3× iNOS HRE, pGL3-promoter) maintained in 0.5 µg/mL puromycin; mycoplasma-tested; ≤30 passages. siRNA at 27 nM final in 35 mm plates with Interferin; 48 h siRNA; 1% O2, 5% CO2, 37 °C in an Invivo2 300 workstation for 24 h; lysis inside the workstation; Passive Lysis Buffer; luciferase normalised to Bradford protein; n=3 biological replicates. Interferin (Sartorius/Polyplus protocol; https://api.sartorius.com/document-hub/dam/download/282472/siRNA-miRNA-Transfection-Reagent-INTERFERin-Protocol-en-Sartorius.pdf): seed 150,000 ± 50,000 cells per 6-well/35 mm in 2 mL. At 10–50 nM siRNA use 12 ± 4 µL INTERFERin in 200 µL serum-free medium, 2 mL complete medium, 2.2 mL final volume. Vortex INTERFERin 5 s; vortex the siRNA+INTERFERin mix 10 s; incubate 10 min at room temperature (≤30 min). Gene silencing is typically assessed at 24–72 h for mRNA and 48–96 h for protein. Promega TB281 (https://www.promega.com/-/media/files/resources/protocols/technical-bulletins/0/luciferase-assay-system-protocol.pdf): 1X lysis reagent (dilute 5X PLB 1:4), PBS rinse, lyse and scrape (400 µL per 60 mm dish), vortex 10–15 s, centrifuge 12,000 × g for 15 s at room temperature or up to 2 min at 4 °C. Assay: 20 µL lysate + 100 µL Luciferase Assay Reagent, 2 s delay, 10 s read. Promega Dual-Luciferase manual (https://www.promega.com/-/media/files/resources/protocols/technical-manuals/0/dual-luciferase-reporter-assay-system-protocol.pdf): 1X PLB per well is 250 µL (12-well), 100 µL (24-well), 20 µL (96-well); no 35 mm/6-well volume was found. Bio-Rad Bradford: dilute dye 1:5, BSA standards, read at 595 nm (https://users.pfw.edu/blumenth/LabData/BioradLab.pdf). The bioRxiv full text (https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.03.26.714448v1.full) has the same methods and adds no further detail; the proliferation assay states that hypoxia starts 24 h after reverse transfection."}
